results.subject: physics
results.note: Magnetic braking. The entering phase solves dv/dt = -K v, v = v0 exp(-K t), which OV can now check (exp ring) but not derive. Option D needs exp(-ln(3/2)) = 2/3, i.e. exp of an ln: the normal form has exp and ln atoms (D-030) but no rule exp(ln u) = u, so the time cannot be certified; option A needs the same entering-distance bound. It also needs an electromagnetic-induction library (force B^2 L^2 v / R on a partly entered loop), not drafted.
